metadata.name: Catalogue sync
metadata.description: One setup of a branch library's onboarding: where the branch's catalogue comes from, how often it syncs, and who hears when a sync fails. Three myapp.step blocks over priv/fixtures/catalogue_sync_screens.json, so the person setting it up may go back to the step before. Runnable alone, and written to run as a child of the onboarding: its root finishes with the outcome done.

datamodel.description: What the steps collected, keyed by question key. Each myapp.step writes responses.<key> for the keys it names, from the press that finished it.
